messages.subject: Re: [Rqtl-disc] plot.rf
parts:
I tried to plot pairwise rf and LOD scores for chr9 [only 14 markers].

the pdf is 12.6 MB. it struggles to open and only does so partially.

It appears as if all chr are in the plot.

script is below:

 

##map LG9

library(qtl)

All_q50C50 <- read.cross("csvr", ".", "All_q50C50copy2a.csv", estimate.map=FALSE)

#removes 4 ind

All_q50C50 <- All_q50C50 [ , -c( 8, 35, 37, 90)]

summary(All_q50C50)

#remove dis seg markers

gt <- geno.table(All_q50C50)

#gt[gt$P.value < 0.05/totmar(All_q50C50),]

todrop<- rownames(gt[gt$P.value < 1e-10,])

All_q50C50trim <- drop.markers(All_q50C50, todrop)

#summary(All_q50C50trim)

All_q50C50trim <- est.rf(All_q50C50trim)

#check if alleles switched

#checkAlleles(All_q50C50trim, threshold=5)

#form LG, earlier tested and found these parameters gave balance b/t no. of LG and no. markers per LG

All_q50C50trim <- formLinkageGroups(All_q50C50trim, max.rf=0.35, min.lod=8, reorgMarkers=TRUE)

#maps markers to chr9

All_q50C50trim <- orderMarkers(All_q50C50trim, chr=9)

tried:

plot.rf(All_q50C50trim, alternate.chrid=TRUE)

plot.rf(All_q50C50trim, alternate.chrid=FALSE)

plot.rf(All_q50C50trim)

the output was the same for all

thanks

messages.author: 96353e7106735838
messages.subject: Re: [Rqtl-disc] plot.rf
parts:
You want

plot.rf(All_q50C50trim, chr=9)

This line orders the markers only on chromosome 9, but it doesn't remove the rest of the chromosomes.

All_q50C50trim <- orderMarkers(All_q50C50trim, chr=9)

karl
